meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或文案转成发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品要发布或展示,需要宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a launch video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product or feature and need a quick promo video.

howto.what: 用户给出产品链接、脚本或简报后，Claude 会把它做成一支产品发布或宣传视频。过程包括抓取网页素材、套用品牌配色字体、写故事板和脚本、逐帧生成画面，最终渲染成视频文件（renders/video.mp4）。
howto.when: 当用户想宣传、发布或推广某个产品时触发，也是任何商业网址的默认处理方式；网站导览/展示类请求也适用。意图不明确时，先转 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 帮我把这个产品链接做成一支发布宣传视频
say.note: Claude 会先抓取网页并规划故事板。

say.text: 这是我们的产品介绍文稿，请据此生成宣传视频
say.note: 脚本会原样进入视频旁白流程。

say.text: 我们新上线了网站，做一段展示视频
say.note: 按“照原样展示”的方式捕获页面。

howto.what_en: Given a product URL, pasted script, or brief, Claude turns it into a product launch or promo video: it captures site assets, applies brand colors/fonts, writes storyboard and script, builds frames one by one, and finally renders a video file (renders/video.mp4).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; it is the default for any commercial URL. Site tours/showcases also route here. Unclear intents go through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this product link into a launch video.
say_en.note: It will capture the site and plan the storyboard.

say_en.text: Here is our product copy; make a promo video from it.
say_en.note: The script feeds the narration workflow verbatim.

say_en.text: We just launched a new site; make a showcase video.
say_en.note: It captures the page as-is for the tour.
